text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on inference-gateway (edge pool) starting ~09:12 UTC. Error rate jumped to ~18% from baseline 0.4%. Latency p50 -> 220ms, p95 -> 1.6s. Paging oncall.

alex: oncall here, I'm looking at grafana now. Which route is the spike pinned to?

maya: seeing a large spike on route /v1/generate -> backend set 'worker-gpu-v2'. 503s and 504s mostly. Logs show a lot of upstream connection failures and 'resource exhausted' from Envoy. :eyes:

jordan_sre: I can grab proxy logs. Quick check: have we recently rolled any lb or envoy config? deploy-bot: the last envoy config push was 2024-11-20T08:50 (cf: cfg-20241120-envoy-retry-change). That changed retry policy and circuit_breaker defaults for the edge pool.

lee_ops: confirming, the rollout toggled retry_on: 5xx and increased max_retries to 3 for infra-wide, plus new circuit_breaker low concurrency on worker-gpu-v2 (max_connections: 30). That was to protect cold backends but might be too conservative.

alex: that matches the symptoms — low circuit breaker thresholds + aggressive retries can amplify load and cause upstream to hit limits -> 5xx surge. Can we throttle traffic away from worker-gpu-v2 and remove retries as quick mitigation?

maya: I'm going to shift route weights now. Plan: - reduce weight to 0 for worker-gpu-v2 in the gateway route set (shadow traffic stays). - enable fallback to worker-gpu-v1. Doing via routing API: `curl -X PATCH https://admin-api/routes/edge -d '{"backends":{"worker-gpu-v2":0,"worker-gpu-v1":100}}'`

sam_runtime: hold on before patching retries. If we remove retries entirely some clients may see timeouts instead of quick 503s. I think removing retry_on: 5xx at the gateway level is safe short-term. I'll prepare a hotfix to set `retry_on: none` for edge cluster and bump circuit_breaker thresholds to more permissive values for worker-gpu-v2 (connections -> 500) until we stabilize.

jordan_sre: I'm pulling envoy stats from the edge: `admin/stats?filter=cluster.worker-gpu-v2` — connection_opened spikes and `pending_requests` is high. Also seeing a lot of `upstream_rq_retry` increments which indicates retry amplification.

maya: patch applied: route weights swapped, worker-gpu-v2 -> 0. Confirming traffic now flowing to worker-gpu-v1. Monitoring dashboard — 5xx rate falling from 18% -> 6% within 40s.

alex: good. jordan, can you apply the retry hotfix? sam will prepare cfg rollback if needed.

jordan_sre: applying hotfix to disable retries on edge cluster now. `kubectl -n edge exec envoy-pod -- bash -c "sed -i 's/retry_on: 5xx/retry_on: none/' /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml && curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:19000/runtime_reload"`

deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy started: cfg-hotfix/disable-edge-retries by jordan_sre at 09:22 UTC.

lee_ops: I'm raising circuit_breaker connection limit for worker-gpu-v2 from 30 -> 500 via temporary patch. `kubectl patch configmap envoy-cluster-config -p '{"data":{"worker-gpu-v2-cb":"max_connections: 500"}}'`

sam_runtime: stacking mitigations: route weight change + retries disabled + cb bump. Keep an eye on tail latency; we may have some backlog as connections ramp.

maya: 5xx currently at 1.8% and trending down. p95 latency back to 300ms. Looks stable.

cara_product: quick customer impact note: initial blast affected some paying customers on low-volume plans; alerts triggered in the SLO dashboard. I'm drafting a short status update for status.redwood.ai to mention transient errors and mitigation in progress.

alex: can we root-cause this? hypothesis: the config change reduced circuit_breaker capacity too far for worker-gpu-v2 which, combined with retries_on:5xx, led to retry amplification and overload. We should audit the roll that introduced the change.

jordan_sre: will open an incident ticket and attach config diffs. Git commit for the config change: `commit: 9a3f2b7 cfg-20241120-envoy-retry-change` — added `retry_on: 5xx` and lowered cb settings for several GPU backends.

sam_runtime: action items: 1) revert the risky config in edge -> create rollback PR to restore previous cb defaults and remove global retry_on:5xx 2) add a canary gating to any retry policy changes 3) run a load test against worker-gpu-v2 to validate cb sizing 4) add better alerting to detect retry amplification (upstream_rq_retry rate > threshold). I'll own the PR.

alex: oncall handoff: I'm paged until 10:00 UTC. If traffic re-spikes escalate to SRE pager. jordan, please own postmortem and link to runbook entry.

jordan_sre: acknowledged. Creating incident ticket INC-20241201-001 and assigning postmortem. Adding mitigations and timeline.

cara_product: status update posted: "We detected elevated error rates for requests to our inference gateway; traffic was shifted and retries disabled to mitigate. We're monitoring and investigating root cause. No ongoing degradation for most customers." (link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20241201-001)

maya: final note — rolling restart of envoy pods not required after runtime_reload, but if we see lingering connection stalls I'll trigger a rolling restart with drain set to 60s.

alex: thanks everyone. Will keep thread updated if anything changes. :thumbsup:
